question: The length of the pitch in cricket is ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**22 yards.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct length of the pitch in cricket is 22 yards or 20.12 meters.**
 
• This measurement is taken from the** bowling crease** to the batting crease.
 
• The length of the pitch has remained the same since the **19th century.**
 
• **The size of the pitch is important in cricket as it affects the gameplay and scoring opportunities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The pitch is a rectangular area of the ground that is 22 yards long and 10 feet wide.**
 
• **The pitch is made up of different areas including the batting crease, bowling crease, and the popping crease.**
 
• Two teams of eleven players compete in the bat-and-ball game of cricket on a field in the middle of the pitch.
 
• Either team has a wicket at either end, which is made up of two bails balanced on three stumps.
 
• While the bowling and fielding side tries to stop this and **dismiss every batter**, the batting side earns runs by hitting the ball bowled at one of the wickets with the bat and then sprinting between the wickets.
